measure.sourceTitle: The Best 4 Star Hotels in Budapest from $65 | Expedia
measure.evidenceText: Expedia's 4-star Budapest trend table shows August $132. It explicitly says the trend excludes taxes and fees and is based on base rates for a nightly stay for 2 adults found in the last 7 days and averaged for commonly viewed 4-star properties in Budapest.
measure.referencePeriod: Expedia result crawled last week; trend based on base rates found in the last 7 days; August monthly value.
measure.searchQuery: site:expedia.com Budapest Hungary 4-star hotels average nightly price trend 2 adults taxes fees
measure.reason: Accepted as source-feasibility evidence with a known excluded-tax base-rate basis; it is not an inclusive product observation.
